question: Which fixed representations preserve the declared long-run state statistics of a seeded two-layer EBM with synthetic internal stochastic heat exchange, when the physical stochastic process and decoder policy are fixed in advance?
hypothesis: The full two-temperature state preserves mean, zero-lag covariance, lag covariance, and both reservoir variances to floating-point precision. A surface-temperature scalar preserves surface variance but loses deep-reservoir variance and cross-reservoir covariance/lag structure. Duplicating the exact same surface coordinate increases observed dimension without improving any decoded climate statistic.

datasets.quality_control_policy: physical parameters must be finite and positive; values remain the literature-fixed reference fixture

datasets.time_domain: fixed burn-in followed by a seeded stationary-analysis trajectory
datasets.quality_control_policy: AR(1) coefficient, stationary exchange scale, seed, timestep, burn-in, retained sample count, lag, representation matrices, and pseudoinverse policy are immutable experiment inputs

primary_metrics.aggregation_domain: reported separately for each declared fixed representation after reconstruction with the fixture-pinned pseudoinverse
primary_metrics.missing_data_policy: every representation requires the complete retained stochastic trajectory

primary_metrics.aggregation_domain: reported separately for each representation for the fixture-declared lag covariance
primary_metrics.missing_data_policy: every representation requires all retained samples and the declared lag

primary_metrics.aggregation_domain: reported separately for each representation for reconstructed deep-reservoir variance
primary_metrics.missing_data_policy: reference deep variance must be positive and every representation must execute

secondary_metrics.aggregation_domain: reported separately for each representation for reconstructed surface-temperature variance
secondary_metrics.missing_data_policy: reference surface variance must be positive and every representation must execute

secondary_metrics.aggregation_domain: rank of each fixture-declared representation observation matrix
full-state reconstructed zero-lag covariance relative to the physical trajectory covariance
full-state reconstructed lag covariance relative to the physical trajectory lag covariance
redundant surface-pair covariance error minus single surface-scalar covariance error
redundant surface-pair lag-covariance error minus single surface-scalar lag-covariance error
maximum absolute instantaneous total-column budget residual over retained stochastic states
secondary_metrics.missing_data_policy: all retained physical states are required

secondary_metrics.aggregation_domain: maximum absolute direct total-storage contribution of the equal-and-opposite stochastic internal exchange
secondary_metrics.missing_data_policy: all retained exchange samples are required

negative_controls: the stochastic exchange flux enters the surface and deep storage equations with exactly opposite extensive contributions and is not treated as external radiative forcing
the physical stochastic trajectory is generated from one fixture-pinned seed and candidate/baseline execution must agree on its digest
the surface scalar is allowed to lose deep-reservoir and cross-reservoir statistics; no learned hidden-state reconstruction is introduced
the redundant surface pair duplicates one identical surface coordinate and must remain structural rank one
mean, zero-lag covariance, lag covariance, surface variance, and deep variance are reported separately; no aggregate climate-statistics score is produced
falsifiers: the stochastic internal exchange directly sources or sinks total column storage
candidate and baseline executions disagree on the physical trajectory digest
the identity full-state representation fails to preserve zero-lag or lag covariance to floating-point tolerance
duplicating the surface coordinate improves decoded covariance or lag-covariance statistics materially
the synthetic AR(1) variability is reported as a calibrated model of observed internal climate variability
split_policy: No model or decoder is fit. A fixed burn-in is discarded and the following seeded trajectory is used only for deterministic statistics-preservation diagnostics.
preprocessing: Apply only the fixture-declared linear observation matrices and fixed Moore-Penrose pseudoinverses. Statistics use population-normalized centered covariance and the fixture-declared lag.
stopping_rule: Report every declared statistic for every representation. Require exact internal-exchange budget cancellation, trajectory identity across baseline/candidate execution, full-state preservation, and redundancy equivalence without converting the diagnostics into a single score.
multiple_comparison_policy: All representation matrices, stochastic-process parameters, seed, burn-in, retained sample count, and lag are fixed by this experiment version.
